title: CAD Automation Bridges — SolidWorks, Inventor, FreeCAD, Mastercam, Fusion360, hyperMILL

completion_audit.finding: Milestone metadata was 'completed_units: 0' / 'status: ready' but every unit had a working implementation file plus extensive test coverage. Reality was ~95% done with 7 stale-test failures (envelope-shape drift + Windows handle exhaustion in stress test).
completion_audit.test_state_at_audit: 237/244 pass before fixes (97%), 245/245 pass after — all 12 implementation files exist, dispatcher exposes 359 actions (grew from original 14 baseline as later units added AI/planner/decomposer surfaces), 9 specialty dispatcher tests passing (gtRegistry, gtValidation, universalIndex, native parsers, dimensional sig, feature memory, feature tree, step pipeline, cgt0607).
fixes_applied: cadAutomation-integration.test.ts: dispatch() helper hardened against res.content undefined; 'exactly 14 actions' assertion changed to '>= 14 floor + canonical-actions-present check' matching cadAutomationDispatcher.test.ts pattern.
cadAutomationDispatcher.test.ts: invoke() helper hardened against res.content undefined.

cadProcessSpawner.test.ts: stress loop now retries on Windows UNKNOWN/EAGAIN/EMFILE handle-pressure errors with linear backoff (5 retries × 50ms × attempt) — preserves the 100-cycle invariant while tolerating OS rate-limiting.

goal: Establish programmatic automation bridges for all 6 CAD systems so PRISM can open, inspect, export, and re-generate native files without human interaction. Without these bridges, the 20K-file regression test cannot access native CAD content at scale.
ultimate_test_contribution: Each bridge unlocks a different slice of the 20,006-file corpus: SolidWorks .sldprt/.sldasm, Inventor .ipt/.iam, FreeCAD .FCStd, Mastercam .mcx*, Fusion360 .f3d, hyperMILL .hmc. Without bridges, files are opaque binary blobs.

exit_criteria.all_six_bridges_operational: Each bridge opens a native file, extracts feature tree, exports to STEP, closes cleanly
exit_criteria.install_detection_working: CADInstallationProbeEngine reports {installed:bool, version, path} for each CAD system
exit_criteria.mock_layer_complete: CI can run without real CAD installs — mock layer returns deterministic fixtures
exit_criteria.process_lifecycle_clean: Bridges spawn → execute → terminate processes; zero orphan processes after 100-file batch
exit_criteria.automation_dispatcher_wired: MCP client can invoke cad_automation.open_file / export_step / close for any format

units.title: CADInstallationProbeEngine — detect installed CAD software
deliverables: src/engines/CADInstallationProbeEngine.ts
Probes registry (Windows), file system, and well-known paths for each CAD system
Returns {cadSystem, installed, version, installPath, executablePath, apiVersion}
Covers: SolidWorks, Inventor, FreeCAD, Mastercam, Fusion360, hyperMILL
units.exit: Probe correctly identifies all installed CAD systems on target workstation

units.title: SolidWorksAutomationBridge — COM-based .sldprt/.sldasm/.slddrw access
deliverables: src/engines/SolidWorksAutomationBridge.ts
bridges/solidworks/SolidWorksBridge.cs (C# COM host, compiled to .exe)
Spawns sldworks.exe via COM Interop (SldWorks.Application)
Operations: open, getFeatureTree, exportSTEP, exportPDF, getBoundingBox, close
IPC: stdin/stdout JSON over named pipe
Timeout: 60s per operation, kills process on timeout
units.exit: Bridge opens .sldprt → extracts 100 features → exports to STEP → closes in <30s

units.title: InventorAutomationBridge — COM-based .ipt/.iam/.idw access
deliverables: src/engines/InventorAutomationBridge.ts
bridges/inventor/InventorBridge.cs (C# COM host)
Spawns Inventor via COM (Inventor.Application)
Operations: open, getParameters, getModelTree, exportSTEP, getMassProperties, close
Handles iAssembly/iPart part-number-driven variants
IPC: JSON over named pipe
units.exit: Bridge opens .ipt → extracts feature tree → exports STEP → closes <30s

units.title: FreeCADAutomationBridge — Python-based .FCStd access
deliverables: src/engines/FreeCADAutomationBridge.ts
bridges/freecad/freecad_bridge.py (FreeCAD Python console script)
Spawns FreeCADCmd.exe with bridge script
Operations: open, getDocument, getObjects, exportSTEP, getSpreadsheets, close
IPC: stdin/stdout JSON
FCStd is ZIP-based: also supports direct parsing via zip+xml
units.exit: Bridge opens .FCStd → extracts objects → exports STEP → closes <20s

units.title: MastercamAutomationBridge — NET-Hook for .mcx* / .mcam
deliverables: src/engines/MastercamAutomationBridge.ts
bridges/mastercam/MastercamNetHook.cs (NET-Hook DLL)
NET-Hook loads into Mastercam.exe process via -runchook argument
Operations: open, getGeometry, getToolpaths, getOperationTree, exportSTEP
Handles .mcx-8 (Mastercam 2018+) and legacy .MCX
Named-pipe IPC with host PRISM process

units.title: Fusion360AutomationBridge — HTTP bridge for .f3d/.f3z
deliverables: src/engines/Fusion360AutomationBridge.ts
bridges/fusion360/fusion_http_addin/ (Fusion360 add-in)
Add-in starts HTTP server on localhost:8765 when Fusion360 launches
Operations: open_f3d, get_timeline, export_step, export_stl, close
Leverages Fusion360 Python API (adsk.core, adsk.fusion)
Requires Fusion360 session — queues requests if Fusion is busy
units.exit: Bridge opens .f3d via HTTP → extracts timeline → exports STEP → closes <30s

units.title: HyperMILLAutomationBridge — AC Python for .hmc
deliverables: src/engines/HyperMILLAutomationBridge.ts
bridges/hypermill/hm_bridge.py (hyperMILL AC Python script)
Loads inside hyperMILL via Application Customization (AC)
Operations: open, get_job_tree, get_parameters, export_step, close
Re-uses existing HyperMILL extraction corpus patterns (25 tips already ingested)
IPC: file-based queue (hyperMILL lacks named pipe API)
units.exit: Bridge opens .hmc → extracts job tree → exports STEP → closes <30s

units.title: CADProcessSpawner — subprocess lifecycle manager
deliverables: src/utils/cadProcessSpawner.ts
Wraps child_process.spawn with: timeout, orphan detection, kill-tree on exit
Tracks spawned PIDs in registry; orphan sweeper runs every 60s
Handles Windows PROCESS_TERMINATE rights for kill-tree
Prevents zombie sldworks.exe / inventor.exe processes from accumulating
units.exit: 100 rapid spawn-kill cycles leave zero orphan processes

units.title: CADAutomationMockLayer — deterministic fixtures for CI
deliverables: src/engines/CADAutomationMockEngine.ts
Returns canned STEP/feature-tree fixtures when CAD not installed
Triggered by env var: PRISM_CAD_MOCK=1
Fixtures: 6 sample outputs per CAD system (simple part, assembly, drawing, CAM, complex, malformed)
Used by CI to run CAD regression tests without $100K CAD licenses
units.exit: vitest suite passes with PRISM_CAD_MOCK=1 on Linux CI runner

units.title: CADAutomationRouter — unified format → bridge selector
deliverables: src/engines/CADAutomationRouterEngine.ts
Maps file extension → correct bridge
Handles fallback: try hyperMILL first, fall back to STEP import if bridge unavailable
Caches bridge-availability detection to avoid repeated probe cost
Policy: prefer native bridge for fidelity, STEP for speed
units.exit: Router correctly dispatches 30 mixed-format files to correct bridges

units.title: CADAutomationDispatcher — MCP action wiring
deliverables: src/tools/dispatchers/CADAutomationDispatcher.ts
Actions: open_file, export_step, export_stl, get_feature_tree, get_parameters, close, probe_installations
z.enum schema validation per action
Wired into MCP server registry
units.exit: MCP client can invoke cad_automation.export_step(file.sldprt) and receive STEP bytes

units.title: Integration test: 30-file multi-format automation smoke
deliverables: src/__tests__/cadAutomationBridges.test.ts
5 files per format (30 total): .sldprt, .ipt, .FCStd, .mcx-8, .f3d, .hmc
Assert: each opens, feature tree extracted, STEP exported, process cleanly terminated
Mock mode fallback for CI
Measure: avg latency per format, total runtime
units.exit: All 30 automation calls succeed; zero orphan processes; latency <60s per file
